name: Cavitation / death

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A cluster of liquid bubbles rapidly implodes into one hollow deep pop, a short pressure ring and a splattering acidic water spray. Vacuum-like watery suction then collapse.
